links.note: Bal Panchayats in Maharashtra bringing many children back to school by convincing parents - this concept's example. Already linked and correct.
The false pair puts the Panchayat Samiti at district level; this concept places it at the block level, as the link between the Gram Panchayat and the Zila Parishad at the district level.

The visible statement concerns the election of Zila Parishad members, and this concept states that the members of these institutions are elected by the local people. The item's other numbered statements are missing from the stem.
A drought-prone village transformed by water conservation and mass tree planting with a rising groundwater table is Hiware Bazar, which this concept describes in those terms.
Grassroots level - this concept uses the phrase, saying Panchayats ensure that the benefits of government schemes reach the grassroots level, which is the most local tier of all.
The provision reserving one-third of the seats for women at all three levels - this concept states it. Already linked and correct.

The four units of Kautilya's scheme - sangrahana for 10 villages, karvatika for 100, dronamukha for 400 and sthaniya for 800 - are this concept's list, against which the invented antarjala is the outsider.
Panchayats playing a vital role in ensuring that the benefits of government schemes reach the grassroots level - this concept's sentence, which is the assertion word for word.

The false pair gives the Panchayat Samiti a national defence role; this concept sets out its actual work, coordinating matters across Gram Panchayats and collecting their development plans for the district and state levels, and the Zila Parishad's district plans alongside.
Governance brought closer to the people, enabling their active participation - this concept's phrase for what the Panchayat system does, which is what grassroots democracy names.
Bal Panchayats in Maharashtra working to eliminate child labour and child marriage - this concept's example. Already linked and correct.
Sangkhu Radhu Khandu Gram Panchayat in West Sikkim building compound walls for schools and kitchens for mid-day meals - this concept's account. Already linked and correct.
The Children's Parliament, an offshoot of Bunker Roy's Barefoot College, empowering underprivileged children in Rajasthan's rural areas. Already linked and correct.
The Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana, which promotes the construction of all-weather roads in rural areas - this concept names the scheme while explaining how development funds are allotted.

The false pair credits Dnyaneshwar Kamble with promoting sports; this concept records what Kamble is actually known for, being a transgender Sarpanch elected against six candidates with the motto lok seva, gram seva, and it also holds Vandana Maida's work.
The elected head of the village council whom villagers would approach is the Sarpanch or Pradhan - this concept states that each Gram Panchayat elects such a head.
The Children's Parliament as an offshoot of Bunker Roy's Barefoot College initiative - this concept's sentence. Already linked and correct.
Comparing Kautilya's sthaniya for 800 villages with a modern Zila Parishad - this concept gives the figure and explicitly asks what names we would give these four categories in today's language.
About 600,000 villages in India - this concept's figure. Already linked and correct.
A population that has crossed 1.4 billion - this concept's figure. Already linked and correct.
Almost two-thirds of the population living in rural areas - this concept's figure. Already linked and correct.
The system of local government in Indian villages called a Panchayat, which refers to a village council - this concept's definition.
The system working at three levels, village, block and district - this concept names the three-tier arrangement.
The Gram Panchayat at the base of the diagram, closest to the people in rural areas - this concept places it there.
The Panchayat Samiti at the block level as the middle tier - this concept is where the block-level institution is described.
The Zila Parishad at the district level as the highest tier within a district - this concept describes it.

Who makes up the Gram Sabha - this concept defines it as the adults of a village or group of neighbouring villages who are enrolled as voters. Already linked and correct. Note: the printed answer belongs to a different question, on the Panchayat Secretary's duties.
